hooks.command: bash -c 'set -e; NAME=$(python3 -c "import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin)[\"name\"])"); REPO_ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); WORKTREE_PATH="$REPO_ROOT/.claude/worktrees/$NAME"; mkdir -p "$REPO_ROOT/.claude/worktrees"; git -C "$REPO_ROOT" worktree add "$WORKTREE_PATH" -b "worktree-$NAME" dev >&2; cd "$WORKTREE_PATH"; [ -f "$REPO_ROOT/.env" ] && cp "$REPO_ROOT/.env" .env >&2; git submodule update --init --recursive >&2; pnpm install >&2; pnpm --filter @carlonicora/nestjs-neo4jsonapi build >&2; pnpm --filter @carlonicora/nextjs-jsonapi build >&2; echo "$WORKTREE_PATH"'
